title: Cricbet99 Safety Report
subtitle: A technical and operational breakdown of the multi-layered security protocols that keep India's #1 betting community safe.

faqs.q: Is my money safe with Cricbet99?
faqs.a: Yes. Player funds are held in secure, segregated accounts and are always available for instant withdrawal via verified UPI or bank channels.
We use mandatory OTP verification for logins and sensitive account changes, making unauthorized access virtually impossible.
WhatsApp provides end-to-end encryption. Our official business accounts add an extra layer of verification to ensure you are speaking with our real team.

faqs.a: We have never had a breach since 2020. However, we maintain rigorous incident response plans and regular security audits to prevent such events.
